title: FeatureFuzz: Treating Bug-prone Features as Core Primitives for Compiler Fuzzing
abstract: arXiv:2601.12360v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: CI/CD pipelines often execute build and test tasks with high privileges, making the compilation stage security-sensitive. In this setting, malicious pull requests may exploit carefully crafted source code to trigger arbitrary code execution or excessive resource consumption during compilation, making compiler vulnerabilities security-relevant. Recent work has leveraged bug-prone knowledge from historical bugs to drive compiler exploration and bug discovery. However, many compiler bugs depend on program semantics rather than syntax, and existing approaches either rely on syntactic mutation or encode this knowledge in model parameters, making it difficult to preserve and recombine the semantics that actually trigger compiler bugs. We propose FeatureFuzz, a compiler fuzzer that explicitly reuses bug-prone semantics through features and feature groups. translated_title: FeatureFuzz：将易错特性作为编译器模糊测试的核心原语
translated_abstract: CI/CD流水线通常以高权限执行构建和测试任务，这使得编译阶段具有安全敏感性。在这种环境下，恶意拉取请求可能利用精心构造的源代码在编译过程中触发任意代码执行或过度的资源消耗，从而使编译器漏洞具有安全相关性。近期的工作利用从历史缺陷中提取的易错知识来驱动编译器探索与缺陷发现。然而，许多编译器缺陷依赖于程序语义而非语法，现有方法要么依赖语法变异，要么将此类知识编码在模型参数中，难以保留并重组真正触发编译器缺陷的语义。我们提出FeatureFuzz，一种通过特性和特性组显式重用易错语义的编译器模糊测试工具。FeatureFuzz从历史缺陷中提取这些易错语义作为特性，并对其实施……
tldr: 提出FeatureFuzz，一种将从历史缺陷中提取的易错语义显式建模为特性和特性组并加以重用的编译器模糊测试工具，从而更有效地发现依赖程序语义的编译器缺陷。
en_tdlr: FeatureFuzz is a compiler fuzzer that explicitly reuses bug-prone semantics extracted from historical bugs as features and feature groups, enabling more effective discovery of semantics-dependent compiler bugs.
